name: finance-contextos
description: Build your company's ContextOS — the finance context Claude loads before touching your numbers. One guided session drafts your account map from QuickBooks, captures your definitions and judgment calls into a durable finance profile, and proves the result ties to your live books. One connector (QuickBooks, read-only, your own login), one review, yours to keep. Start here; add the All Systems Go plugin later for more connectors and workflows.
